name: flow-field
title: Flow field
description: A wind map: streamlines of a slowly turning, swirling flow, with bright streaks that travel along them and leave fading tails.

name: voronoi
title: Voronoi Cells
description: A cellular surface like soap foam, crackle glaze or raised stone tiles, with walls of one width and seeds that drift so cells swell, shrink and trade edges.

name: galaxy
title: Galaxy
description: A tilted spiral galaxy turning slowly, with a bright core, arms with knots of stars, dust lanes and fixed stars behind.

name: fire
title: Fire
description: Flames rising from the edge of the box, with a hot base, tapering tongues that lick up and tear off, and embers that drift above them.
